text:
Nina: Quick follow-up from the all-hands 1: leadership asked for concrete dates on two items: Console traffic controls (UI + API) and Optimize's model-tuning recommendations. Customers are asking for betas.

Sam (Product): Console traffic controls: aiming for private beta by 2026-05-18, public beta the week of 2026-06-22. Caveat: depends on the API parity PR and the quota backend migration.

Diego (Runtime): The quota migration is in staging. If staging rollback happens we'll lose a week. I'm optimistic but flagging risk.

Priya (DevEx): Docs plan? I can prepare a condensed "what's new" and a short migration guide for teams affected by per-route limits. ETA: draft by Fri.

Sam (Product): Great. Optimize recommendations (batch size + quant profiles): internal alpha next Tue (small set of customers), public beta mid-July. Initially hosted-only; Dedicated/DMS support targeted for Q3.

Liam (Sales): Heads-up: a couple of enterprise prospects requested Dedicated support earlier. Can we get a rough Q3 month? Without it they may pause purchasing conversations.

Diego (Runtime): Q3 target is August for Dedicated support (tentative). We'll need a Dedicated smoke pass for quantized models on A100 and T4 variants.

Priya (DevEx): For the Optimize beta UX, do we have an example payload for the recommendations API? I can add sample SDK calls to the docs.

Sam (Product): Basic snippet landing in docs will look like: 

```
POST /v1/optimize/recommendations
{ "model": "redwood-xxl-quant", "workload_sample": "s3://bucket/prompts.json" }
```

Diego (Runtime): Note: the endpoint currently returns suggestions with a confidence score. We're adding a "safety" flag if the eval harness detects >1% quality drop.

eval-bot: Eval harness run queued (run_id: 20260501-73). Estimated runtime: 30m.

Nina: Important: leadership wants a one-sentence customer-ready line for each item we can share today. Sam, can you provide those?

Sam (Product): Sure: "Console traffic controls (UI + API): private beta mid-May, public beta late June; dependent on quota backend migration (possible 1-2 week delay)." / "Optimize recommendations: internal alpha early May, public beta mid-July; hosted-only at launch, Dedicated support planned for August (Q3) after smoke validation."

Priya (DevEx): I'll turn Sam's lines into a short FAQ and add SDK examples. PR incoming: https://git.internal.redwood/docs/pull/488 (WIP).

Diego (Runtime): ops-bot, current staging quota migration status?

ops-bot: Quota migration in staging: 5/6 services migrated, health checks green. Estimated cutover to canary: 2026-05-10.

eval-bot: Eval harness completed. No regressions >0.8% detected on the 100-prompt suite. Details: https://infra.internal.redwood/evals/20260501-73

Liam (Sales): I'll wait for the FAQ before outreach. If docs are ready Mon/Tue I can brief accounts mid-week.

Nina: Thanks everyone. Action items: Priya to publish FAQ + SDK snippet, Diego to watch quota migration and flag slips, Sam to update roadmap entries, Liam to hold outreach till FAQ. We'll sync next week if anything changes. :thumbsup:
